Primary upstream license texts copied verbatim from exact npm tarballs.
mermaid-bundled/: 59 exact outer dependency versions (54 package names).
mermaid-parser/: 12 additional exact versions embedded in the parser chunk.
KaTeX-FONTS-NOTICE.txt: actual font copyright/RFN metadata; OFL text is in ../../fonts/LICENSE-OFL.txt.
Phosphor-Icons-LICENSE.txt: original 2020-2024 MIT notice from the owner-provided icon collection.
roughjs-children/: original MIT notices for four exact locked dependencies, deduplicated to three distinct copyright/permission texts. Build tools are not distributed.
See ../../resource-licenses.json for file hashes, component mapping and unresolved distribution review. Notice retrieval is not a complete recursive license clearance.
